titles.romaji: Kakyuusei 2: Hitomi no Naka no Shoujo-tachi
titles.native: 下級生２ ～瞳の中の少女たち～

description: Many people have fond memories of meeting a certain teenage boy in their younger years. However, their ages vary widely, and each remembers him as a teen. This story follows the intricate intertwining of their various stories and how this young man, who apparently lives outside of time, has affected each of them.
